gloss_en: Holy boldness (azut di-kedushah): the sanctified brazenness/audacity of holiness — spiritual firmness drawn from joy and expressed in the holy voices (e.g., the shofar cry, the sigh) — by which one receives the Torah, attains faith, approaches the true tzaddikim, and breaks the insolence of the body and of the Other Side; the opposite of azut of the sitra achra
